title: Ag2WO4 nanocatalyst-driven green synthesis of pyrano[2,3-d]pyrimidinones: an integrated experimental, DFT, and cytotoxic investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3580-3601
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08635C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sathiaseelan Perumal, Perumal Muthuraja, M. Sasikumar, R. Hari Krishna, Paramasivam Manisankar, Viswanathan Subramanian
Ag2WO4 nanoparticles catalyse a green multicomponent synthesis of pyrano[2,3-d]pyrimidinones in aqueous ethanol, supported by DFT, molecular docking, MD simulations, ADME profiling, and in vitro cytotoxicity against A549 cells.
